notes.title: Release date of Act III
notes.notes: [p]By royal decree, I hereby announce the release date of Act III — September 27. I understand that a 28-day delay from the schedule is not the most pleasant event in the life of the kingdom, but it’s better to polish and test everything thoroughly than to roll out Tenebris’s raw excrements.[/p]

notes.title: Voiceover Update and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]A big hello from Valendor! Today I'm rolling out an update that’s large in size but not in the number of fixes: you can now choose between narrated and machine voiceover for quests and events in both the English and Russian versions. Please note that the second chapter hasn’t yet been recorded by the narrator, but I’ll be uploading this update later this week.[/p][p]I’ve also fixed a bug that prevented achievements from being awarded. This week I’ll announce the exact release date for Act III, it will definitely come out in September, but there’s still plenty of cleanup to do with errors and bugs.[/p]

notes.title: Critical error after yesterday's update.
notes.notes: [p]After yesterday’s addition of several effects, a bug may (or may not) occur when winter begins — the map remains in its autumn state. There’s also an issue with the generation of certain quests between turns 26 and 30. I’m currently fixing these bugs, which I didn’t catch during the build testing. A new build will be published tonight.[/p][p][/p]
